about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport P530 is the flagship petrol V8 model in the current L461 generation, introduced in 2022. Under the bonnet, it uses the BMW N63 twin-turbo V8, a 4.4-litre unit that represents a significant departure from the previous supercharged AJ-V8 engines used in older models. This engine is shared with the larger L460 Range Rover, reflecting the deep platform sharing between the two models. The P530's V8 offers a blend of performance and refinement that is central to the Range Rover Sport's character, and our rebuild service is designed to restore this engine to its full potential.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace BMW N63 engines for every Range Rover Sport P530 on the road.

compatibility.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 ENGINE
compatibility.intro: The P530 uses a specific BMW-sourced engine code (N63) that is distinct from the other engines in the L461 lineup (the Ingenium 6-cylinder units) and entirely different from the AJ-V8 family used in the previous L494 generation. Fitting the wrong replacement or assuming a part from a different engine will work can lead to expensive compatibility issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code via registration or VIN - Your generation (L461) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
